connector.name: Freelancer MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search, bid, and message clients on Freelancer.com from Claude. Multi-account support.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package freelancer-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the godesigntech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FREELANCER_OAUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Personal Access Token for a single Freelancer.com account. Get one at https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop

env.name: FREELANCER_ACCOUNTS
env.description: JSON object mapping account labels to Personal Access Tokens, for connecting multiple Freelancer.com accounts in one server, e.g. {"main":"token1","client_acme":"token2"}
